items.q: Is this a history of the 1979 battles?
items.a: **No. It is the fuse.** Aid from 1950, the 1978 border, the Soviet treaty, Deng's US/Japan trip, then Xu Shiyou's 04:05 start on 17 February. Combat results wait for later episodes.

items.q: What kind of source is this?
items.a: A Bilibili scripted recap (~50 min, ~400k-character series bible). **Video claims, not a monograph.** Whisper names are messy; use standard forms (Le Duan, Chen Geng, Giáp, Wei Guoqing, Dien Bien Phu).

items.q: What is the video's 1950 origin story?
items.a: Ho asks Stalin for advisors. Stalin says **China handles Vietnam**. Mao, four months after the PRC, agrees to unconditional aid. Chen Geng at Đông Khê; Wei Guoqing's trenches and AA at Dien Bien Phu.

items.q: When does the aid story become the war story?
items.a: After 1975. Le Duan names China the most dangerous enemy. Hoa expelled. Border markers smashed. The video treats this as **[[aid-then-enmity-reversal]]**, not a new dispute.

sections.title: Why they say they had to shoot

items.q: What is Tinghao Mountain in this telling?
items.a: 1 November 1978. Militia clash, then a volley from the heights. Video count: **12 wounded, 6 killed**, captives later executed. Deng: our people were killed on our land. 47 protests already that year.

items.q: What is the northern problem the raid is sized for?
items.a: **[[soviet-vietnam-treaty-encirclement]].** ~500k Soviet troops in the north; 3 November 1978 treaty in the south. Deng's bet: a month-scale raid ends before a six-month Soviet prep.
**[[limited-punitive-war]]**: hit, withdraw, do not occupy. Carter is told in the closed room. The Japan line is that China will teach a lesson. Episode 1 stops at the first shell.
